recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the published FHIR-24898 semantics while preserving later Consent status-family decisions; any future decision to broaden `unknown` beyond formerly active Consent resources should be handled as a separate terminology change.
issue_request: FHIR-24898 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Consent. It requested removing `proposed` and `rejected` from the required Consent.status value set, adding `unknown`, and noting that `unknown` can only be used with formerly active consents.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-24898 was found. The 2019 Consent spreadsheet change in 2da480ca69 appears to be the initial application because it removed `proposed`/`rejected` and added `unknown`; follow-up commits fixed the short list and binding/status-code fallout. The active-only note existed only as a spreadsheet committee note and was not present in the current published CodeSystem definition, while the Consent.status comment still mentioned removed `rejected`.
additional_context: Consent and CodeSystem are active current-build inputs in source/fhir.ini. Later related decisions FHIR-31377 and FHIR-31769 clarify that ConsentState describes the Consent resource, not the patient's consent itself, and FHIR-36263 adds `abandoned` for pre-active expired consent requests; none supersede the FHIR-24898 active-only note for `unknown`.
reconciliation: Updated source/consent/codesystem-consent-state-codes.xml to include the active-only note in the `unknown` definition using current Consent-resource wording. Updated source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml and source/consent/consent-event-mapping-exceptions.xml to remove stale `rejected` wording from the Consent.status comment.
source_changes: source/consent/codesystem-consent-state-codes.xml: added the public active-only note to the `unknown` concept definition.
source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml: removed the stale removed-code reference to `rejected` from the Consent.status modifier comment.
source/consent/consent-event-mapping-exceptions.xml: aligned the Event.status mapping exception with the updated Consent.status comment.

related_jiras.note: Clarified that ConsentState describes the Consent resource; this fix uses resource-scoped wording.
Resolved no-change decision confirming richer consent/agreement state belongs in the source document rather than expanding ConsentState.
Added `abandoned` for pre-active expired consent requests; this fix preserves that later code while limiting `unknown` to post-active uncertainty.
